Name: The Fish Dimension
Author: ichortower
Description:
[size=6][b][u]The Fish Dimension
[/u][/b][/size][size=3]
A silly mod that forces every randomly-generated Help Wanted quest to be about fish.

Also available on [url=https://github.com/ichortower/TheFishDimension]GitHub[/url].


[/size][size=5][b][u]How it Works
[/u][/b][/size][size=3]
Any generated quest that isn't a FishingQuest or an ItemDeliveryQuest will be reassigned to one of those types (in the same proportion that they are generated by default, about 1:4). All ItemDeliveryQuests will choose randomly from available fish instead of whatever rules they might normally follow.
[/size][size=3]
[/size][size=3]The fish selection for FishingQuests is not changed, but for ItemDeliveryQuests, the new code makes extensive use of context tags, so modded fish should work out of the box if they are tagged correctly. Here's what is checked on the entries in Data/Objects:[/size][size=3]
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]must be in the fish category (-4, i.e. actual fish)[/size]
[*][size=3]must have the tag "season_<current season>" OR "season_all"[/size]
[*][size=3]must not have the tag "fish_mines"[/size]
[*][size=3]must not have the tag "fish_legendary"[/size]
[*][size=3]if the bus is not repaired, must not have the tag "fish_desert"[/size]
[*][size=3]if no player has the dark talisman, must not have the tags "fish_bug_lair" or "fish_swamp"[/size]
[*][size=3]if ginger island is not accessible, must not have the tag "fish_ginger_island"[/size]
[/list][size=3]
In order to make the last condition correctly exclude the ginger island fish, this mod also adds the "fish_ginger_island" context tag to the three vanilla ginger island fish.[/size]
